about: Pages served live on perfectnations.com by the Perfect Nations Live Pages plugin. Each key is the id of the page's root element; the plugin serves the file in place of any pasted Custom HTML widget that contains that id. A key written as root@post-slug applies on that one post only, and is used before the plain root (plugin 1.1 or later). 'redirects' lists same-site paths answered with a 301 (plugin 1.1 or later). A change merged into main appears on the site within about ten minutes.
